subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR require a live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection smoke before merge, or may maintainers accept the source/test proof plus the linked issue's live Z.AI edge evidence?
rationale: The contributor cannot access a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key, while repository policy and the external-PR proof gate normally require after-fix real behavior proof for provider API changes.

options.title: Require live smoke first
options.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted endpoint-detection output showing the coding endpoint selected after this change before merge.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the issue's live Z.AI evidence plus the branch regression test as sufficient for this narrow one-header fix.

options.title: Choose another candidate PR
options.body: Maintainers can pick a sibling PR as the canonical landing path and close the remaining duplicate candidates after that path merges.

recommendation.title: Require live smoke first
recommendation.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted endpoint-detection output showing the coding endpoint selected after this change before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the Z.AI endpoint-detection feature and is the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency call.
